name: Amit Gupta
player_statement:
A complete player, Amit Gupta has made a big mark in cricket. With 92 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 38, with an average of 12.26 and a quick strike rate of 77.41. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 94 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 265.0 overs, taking 96 wickets at an economy rate of 8.33. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
